description: This file defines the AWS Route53Client class, a specialized PHP client for interacting with the Amazon Route 53 DNS service, including method signatures, a constructor, and internal ID cleaning logic.

classes.name: Route53Client
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Route 53, extending the base AWS client with additional method signatures and internal ID cleaning functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Route53 client, calling the parent constructor and appending an ID cleaning handler.

methods.name: cleanIdFn
methods.description: Returns a closure that processes commands to clean specific ID parameters before handling.

methods.name: cleanId
methods.description: Removes specific substrings from IDs, such as '/hostedzone/', '/change/', and '/delegationset/', to standardize ID formats.
